neighbours.label: skill-practice activities in sport, dance and music: drills, practice sessions, training exercises, tumbling, circuits (not a medical practice, a power drill or an electrical circuit)
fire: Every session starts with footwork drills and ends with a short scrimmage.
The cheer squad rehearsed tumbling passes and stunts for two hours.
Young pianists should do scales and finger exercises before each lesson.
The goalkeeper stayed after practice to work on diving saves.
Ballet students spend the first hour on barre technique training.
The instructor led the recruits through a twenty-minute circuit of push-ups and sprints.
Swimmers repeat kicking drills until the movement becomes automatic.
With each practice round, the children's passing skills improved.
quiet: Every session of parliament starts with prayers and ends with a vote.
The cheer squad travelled by bus to the stadium for the final.
Young pianists were invited to perform at the town hall concert.
The goalkeeper signed a three-year contract with the club.
The dentist opened a private practice near the station.
The workers used a pneumatic drill to break up the pavement.
Swimmers from twelve countries reached the final on Sunday.
The electrical circuit shorted when water got into the socket.
